page3_img_1.png.title: Commit Information window showing commit list, message, files, and annotations
page3_img_1.png.description: A screenshot of LINKSTER’s Commit Information window titled “Commit Information.” The top pane (callout 1) is a table of commits with columns Revision, Date, Committer, and Message; the row for revision 291452 (2005-09-25, committer “jorton”) is highlighted and shows a message about server/connection.c and a fix. The middle-left pane (callout 2) displays the full commit message including “PR: 35292,” and the lower-left pane (callout 3) lists the affected filename (/httpd/httpd/trunk/server/connection.c). The right-hand annotation area shows checkboxes for change type (callout 4) with “Bug Fix” checked, a Bug IDs list (callout 5) containing 35292, and a free-form Notes box (callout 6) containing the text “fix for issue 35292,” illustrating how a user links a commit to a bug and records annotations.

page3_img_2.png.title: Blame & Diff window with before/after views, thumbnail, and commit guilt annotations
page3_img_2.png.description: Screenshot of LINKSTER’s Blame & Diff window for /httpd/httpd/trunk/server/connection.c showing the commit metadata panel (7) at the top (commit a48b75847e09f85940221c5c67ef132ac0f59526, Author: Jeff Trawick, Date: Thu Apr 13 00:37:55 2000). Two synchronized panes show the file content before commit (8, left) with removed lines highlighted red and prefixed by revision numbers, and after commit (10, right) with added lines highlighted green and marked with ‘+’ and revision 291452; a selected line (revision 84951) is highlighted in blue. A narrow thumbnail overview (9) between the panes visualizes added/removed regions for quick navigation, and the commit status list at the top‑right (11) lists prior commits (e.g., 102800, 93717, 84951) with a dropdown menu for annotating each as unset/guilty/innocent/unsure (one entry shown ticked as “innocent”). The view illustrates how users can inspect exact line origins, navigate changes, and label earlier commits when determining which commit introduced a bug.

page3_img_4.png.title: Message Information window showing emails and linked bug/commit entries
page3_img_4.png.description: Screenshot of LINKSTER’s Message Information window. The top pane (17) shows a scrollable list of mailing-list messages with columns for sender, date, and subject (the highlighted subject reads “Re: [Patch 2.0] d2i_SSL_SESSION args …”). Selecting a message populates the header area (18) with subject, sender email, and timestamp and shows the full message body in the lower pane (19) with quoted replies. To the right (20) is an Associated Items box listing linked records (for example, “Bug : 35292” and “Commit : 291474”, “Commit : 291473”), demonstrating how users can attach bug and commit identifiers to an email for manual cross‑linking and annotation.

page3_img_3.png.title: LINKSTER bug information window showing bug list and detailed entry
page3_img_3.png.description: A GUI window listing bug records in a top table (columns: Bug ID, Date, Description) with one row highlighted (Bug ID 35292, date 2005-09-26, summary about ap_lingering_close). The lower left pane displays structured attributes for the selected bug (e.g., Status: RESOLVED; Severity: trivial; Priority: P2; Product: Apache httpd-2; Version: 2.0-HEAD; Resolution: FIXED). The lower right pane shows the full bug description and chronological comments with message headers and timestamps in a scrollable text area; tabs above this area allow switching between “Extended Bug Entry”, “Bug Activity”, and “Fixing Files”. Visual callouts (numbered 12–16) and a “Drag & Drop” cue indicate that entries can be dragged to other LINKSTER windows to establish associations between bugs, commits, and messages.
